liveReports.name: Caldova Operations Command Center

Use only the existing read-only `azure-mcp_azure` connector and no write actions. Create three tabs. FIRST: **Operations Overview**, showing public endpoint health, Application Gateway backend health, Container Apps revisions/images/replicas/latency, PostgreSQL availability/capacity, reporting heartbeat, alerts, recent changes, and task status with live or explicitly UNKNOWN state, timestamp, provenance, and resource links. SECOND: **Dependency Mapping**, an interactive logical directed map for Internet -> Application Gateway -> portal Azure Container App -> API Azure Container App -> PostgreSQL, Key Vault, ACR, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and reporting worker; show dependency direction, live or explicitly unknown health, evidence time/provenance, and Azure Portal links. Use supported Azure connector discovery, Resource Health, metrics, and Application Insights dependencies where available; do not depend on blocked direct Log Analytics queries. liveReports.name: Caldova FinOps
liveReports.createPrompt: Create a new read-only Live Report named exactly **Caldova FinOps** and save it with that exact name. Use only `caldova-finops_get_caldova_finops`, hard-scoped to subscription `@@SUBSCRIPTION@@` and resource group `@@RG@@`; never use Azure MCP, Azure CLI, or write tools. Invoke the connector on every refresh. Render its structured cascade without terminating when one source is unavailable: Cost Management ActualCost month-to-date daily/service/resource rows plus forecast, budgets, alerts/anomalies, and resource-group-filtered Advisor when supported; then consumption evidence; then live inventory and clearly labeled Azure Retail Prices estimates with assumptions, uptime basis, exclusions, and confidence. Keep actual, forecast, estimate, and potential savings separate; unknown is never zero and observed costs must never be hardcoded. Show daily trend and top-driver charts, sortable driver/findings tables, reliability context, and idle/oversized/orphaned candidates only when supported by returned evidence. Every section must show connector provenance, exact scope, capturedAtUtc/freshness, currency where applicable, unsupported fields, and explicit UNKNOWN states. When `freshness.status` is `cached`, label billed cost **last-known-good** and show `costCapturedAtUtc`, cache age, and the throttle reason; never present cached evidence as a fresh query. Include loading, refresh, partial-failure, and empty states with no write actions. Put the visible marker `CALDOVA-FINOPS-V2` in a provenance footer.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly NSG review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only review of NSG effectiveness and risky rules in the Caldova resource group.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@. Load caldova-operations-handbook and use the caldova-incident-triage discovery order without writes. Inventory every NSG, subnet attachment, effective rule where supported, UDR, private endpoint, DNS dependency, and exposed service. Produce a findings table with resource ID, rule or route, evidence source and UTC, exposure path, impact-based severity, confidence, and recommendation. Identify shadowed, overlapping, unused, overly permissive, or platform-managed rules. Include provenance and explicit missing-evidence states; unavailable effective-rule data is UNKNOWN, never clean. End with preventive, detective, and process recommendations plus a quality gate confirming no Azure changes were made.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly RBAC review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only least-privilege review for identities that can affect Caldova.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@ and its resources. Load caldova-operations-handbook. Enumerate role assignments and role-definition IDs that can affect Caldova; distinguish direct, group-inherited, managed-identity, deny-assignment, and inherited subscription access where evidence permits. Produce a findings table with principal/object ID, principal type, role, scope, assignment origin, observed-use evidence, impact-based severity, and least-privilege recommendation. Cite command/source and UTC. Missing group membership, sign-in, or activity evidence is UNKNOWN, never compliant by inference. Do not create or delete assignments. End with preventive, detective, and process recommendations plus a no-write quality gate.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly cost review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only cost, anomaly, and optimization review for Caldova.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@. Load caldova-finops-runbook, caldova-operations-handbook, and caldova-audit-report. Query 30-day actual cost with Cost Management first, then consumption usage as fallback. If billed data is delayed, empty, unauthorized, throttled, or served from last-known-good cache, preserve that status and capture time; inventory SKUs, regions, counts, and uptime and use Azure Retail Prices only for a clearly labeled estimate with assumptions and exclusions. Report daily trend, top services/resources, budgets, anomalies, Advisor recommendations, and cost-versus-reliability context. Produce a findings table with provenance, freshness, impact-based severity, confidence, and recommendation. Separate actual, forecast, estimate, and potential savings; never add unlike values or render unknown as zero. After the in-thread findings are complete, follow caldova-audit-report to generate, validate, and persist a branded downloadable PowerPoint named Caldova-Weekly-Cost-Review-YYYY-MM-DD.pptx. Do not finish successfully unless SaveFileToBlob confirms that exact real .pptx is attached to the thread; if the supported artifact flow is unavailable, preserve the findings and report the explicit blocker instead of fabricating an attachment. End with quality and closure gates and confirmation that no Azure changes were made.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly capacity review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only capacity and saturation review for Caldova.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@. Load caldova-operations-handbook. Review Application Gateway capacity/backend health, Container Apps replicas, CPU, memory, request latency and revision limits, PostgreSQL compute, storage and connections, reporting-worker CPU, disk and heartbeat, quotas, throttling, and seven-day trends where evidence exists. Produce a findings table with metric/query provenance, UTC range, current value, observed limit, headroom, impact-based severity, confidence, and recommendation. Separate current saturation from forecast risk. Missing metrics or quota evidence is UNKNOWN, not healthy. Do not resize or restart resources. End with preventive, detective, and process recommendations plus a no-write quality gate.

gettingStarted.message: Getting started: Caldova operations. Act as the platform expert for @@RG@@. Load caldova-architecture, caldova-operations-handbook, caldova-finops-runbook, caldova-deployment-evidence, and caldova-cve-evidence-contract. Explain the architecture and request paths, service/dependency catalog, reliability objectives, exact telemetry identifiers and query recipes, role-based RACI and escalation, incident/change lifecycle, permitted remediation boundary, known risks, repository map, and glossary. Validate your understanding by listing the public request path and the reporting path, then perform read-only prerequisite checks for telemetry IDs and evidence access. Record explicit gaps and event-operations handoffs. Do not change Azure.
